info.name: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System
info.description:
API collection aligned with current schema.

Roles: PATIENT | DISPATCHER | ADMIN

Seed logins (password: Password123!):
- admin@dispatch.com
- dispatcher1@dispatch.com
- patient1@dispatch.com

Flow: Auth → create request (PATIENT) → queue/assign (DISPATCHER) → status transitions → select hospital → complete → payment.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public register always creates PATIENT. Promote roles via Admin → Change Role. Login test script saves tokens to collection variables.

request.description: role is ignored/forced to PATIENT on server
Expect 400 Validation failed with field errors

item.name: Ambulances
item.description: Admin create/update/delete. Dispatcher can list + nearest.

request.description: Sets deletedAt — row is not hard-deleted

item.name: Requests
item.description: PATIENT creates/cancels. DISPATCHER/ADMIN list + queue + assign.

request.description: REQUESTED/PRIORITY_ASSIGNED ordered CRITICAL→LOW, then oldest first
Omit ambulanceId → nearest AVAILABLE ambulance selected inside transaction
Expect 409 if ambulance/request already has active dispatch
Fails if already ASSIGNED or beyond

item.name: Dispatch
item.description: Status machine: REQUESTED -> PRIORITY_ASSIGNED -> AMBULANCE_ASSIGNED -> DRIVER_ACCEPTED -> EN_ROUTE -> PATIENT_PICKED_UP -> TO_HOSPITAL -> ARRIVED -> COMPLETED. TO_HOSPITAL only via select-hospital.

request.description: Expect 400 if jumping e.g. AMBULANCE_ASSIGNED → COMPLETED
